setup: if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.envrc" ]; then cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.envrc" .envrc; command -v direnv >/dev/null 2>&1 && direnv allow || true; fi

title.instructions: A few words naming the task, no leading verb and no conventional-commit prefix. Example: Search engine selector fix.

branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-kebab-desc> with type one of feat, fix, chore, docs, ci. Example: fix/duckduckgo-dark-mode.

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits in English: <type>(<scope>): <imperative summary in lowercase>, no trailing period. Types: feat, fix, chore, docs, ci. Scope is optional and names an area such as docs or style. Release commits are 'chore: release vX.Y.Z'.

pullRequest.instructions: Title follows the commit convention. The repo has no PR template, so write a '## Summary' section (what changed and why, linking the issue if any) and a '## Testing' section (pnpm test, pnpm run build, and manual browser checks if the UI changed).
